title: He Chose The Door... But The House Had Other Plans
short_hook: He found his future self trapped inside the walls.
description:
A couple seeks shelter in a secluded glass lodge, only to discover the house is a temporal loop. As the structure turns against them, they must confront a terrifying choice: escape and doom their friend, or stay and be trapped forever. Watch till the end - you won't see the twist coming. What would you choose?
